messages.subject: Climate, ESG & Infrastructure Executive | External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Regenerate Talent Team,

Your executive-search work across climate, clean energy, ESG, sustainability and infrastructure aligns strongly with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where climate and responsible-growth strategy depends on credible institutional and stakeholder engagement. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
